messages:
alex: Heads-up — rolling v3.4.1 to hosted (api-redwood-prod) tomorrow 09:00 PT. Canary plan: 0% → 1% → 5% → 20% over ~45m with optional 60m hold. Need smoke owners, rollback readiness, and geo slices. Details below.
maria: I can own smoke for 09:00 PT. Will run the smoke checklist and watch latency + errors.
jordan: I’ll monitor model KPIs and embedding throughput. Ping me for query-level traces. @kate for infra/scale.
kate: I’m oncall during that window. I’ll watch autoscale, GPU flaps, and pre-warm if needed. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/deploy-smoke (ops section).
sam: Quick q — which model variant are we serving? fp32, fp16, or q4? Need memory headroom numbers.
alex: Serving `gpt-redwood-v2.1` quantized q4_0-lmt (lower mem). Fallback = `v2.0-compat` (fp16).
maria: Smoke checklist I’ll run (will paste commands):
```
# health
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq
# smoke generation (short)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-v2.1","prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":64}' | jq
# embeddings
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/embeddings -d '{"model":"embedder-1","input":"smoke"}' | jq
# simple concurrency load (local)
wrk -t2 -c20 -d120s https://api.redwood.example/generate -s ./smoke.lua
```
jordan: Key metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost/request, GPU memory pressure, KV cache miss rate. Dashboards: /d/smoke/rollout and /d/runtime/gpu.
alex: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to `v2.0-compat` if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 3m. Manual rollback via ops runbook; auto-fallback will trigger if route policy crosses threshold.
kate: On autoscale: I’ll pre-warm one extra GPU and set `reserved_burst: true` for the cohort window. Will toggle 10m before the start.
sam: Can we slice by geo? Recommend excluding APAC for the initial steps. Cohort plan: 1% US-only, 5% US+EU, 20% US+EU.
alex: Yes — rollout policy will exclude apac. Annotating policy as: { 'slices': ['us'], 'exclude': ['apac'] } (in console).
jordan: Canary timing notes: @maria start smoke T+5 after 1% step verification. Hold 5m between steps for metrics stability.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary scheduled by alex for 2026-03-18T09:00:00-07:00. Webhook: https://ci.redwood/deploy/2112349999. Notifications will post to #deployments.
kate: :thumbsup: I’ll be online at 08:45 PT and will confirm pre-warm.
maria: I’ll post smoke logs in this thread. If green, I’ll call +1 to proceed. If anything odd, I’ll request a pause and tag @alex.
sam: lgtm — I’ll stand by for any hotfix CRs.
jordan: One more — enable tracing headers for canary requests (`x-rw-trace`) so we can correlate traces to the cohort.
alex: Added tracing to rollout config and updated notes in the deploy ticket. TL;DR: owner=maria, infra=kate, metrics=jordan, rollback=`v2.0-compat`, exclude=APAC. Thanks all — will post final checklist and the smoke artifact links before EOD. -- alex
